\section{Introduction}
Additively manufactured titanium parts inherit a complex defect population
from the layer-wise build process.
The specimen labelled crack_init$ in our archive failed after only a few thousand cycles,
which motivated a closer look at multiaxial loading paths.

\section{Methods}
Thin-walled tubular specimens were printed in two orientations
and machined to a common gauge geometry.
Tests combine axial load and torsion at several phase angles,
and crack initiation is tracked with replica measurements.
